scope: Every registered AWS, GCP, Azure and Kubernetes native check, the shared analysis checks, and privilege-path finding explanations.
method: Per-check evaluator-bound review ledgers and native fixture replays, followed by review of field-label fallbacks, enum meanings, units, list/count grammar, and uncertain outcomes. Browser fallbacks are covered separately.

azure.baseline: HEAD frontend/src/azureFindingEvidence.ts (unchanged in v2) and v2 frozen native rule JSON
azure.note: Fallback counts measure the formatter; the browser prefers the native rule interpreter where applicable.

requirements.requirement: Every registered native ID has an explanation and a review ledger entry.
requirements.evidence: native-coverage.json; registry-set assertions in provider tests; exact per-ID browser coverage.

requirements.requirement: Explain the observed value and its meaning in simple sentences.
requirements.evidence: Provider-specific review ledgers, recorded branch explanations, and plain-language regression tests; counts and enums are translated before adding the check meaning.

requirements.requirement: Missing evidence must not become zero, false or disabled; a grant must not become proven access.
requirements.evidence: Missing/malformed evidence tests for every check; explicit root credential, public principal, privilege path, and authentication tests.

requirements.requirement: Keep explanations within one to three lines.
requirements.evidence: 20,149 explanations measured with actual inspector CSS and font metrics; zero overflow. No clipping or line clamps.

requirements.requirement: Preserve raw evidence and finding verdicts during wording changes.
requirements.evidence: Immutable-input tests; AWS fixture comparison, GCP finding comparison, and Kubernetes branch evidence hashes match the prior accepted wording revision.

verification.browser: 20 passed, plus strengthened exact-ID coverage gate

limits: Line counts were measured at the normal desktop inspector width; narrower screens can wrap further.
Recorded fixtures cover native outcomes and shapes, not every possible cloud payload or identifier length.
Privilege-path presentation includes synthetic graph cases; no exploitation was attempted.
deployment: Not deployed by the evidence-review agent.
